current_text: Structured COPD self-management, home pulmonary rehabilitation and remote monitoring — the only app in NICE HTE19 with a prior NICE MTG recommendation.

COPD drives high unplanned admissions and significant GP workload. myCOPD gives patients a structured self-management toolkit — including a 6-week home PR programme — without requiring face-to-face PR capacity. The Pro tier adds a clinician dashboard for remote monitoring at population scale.

What is a Class I device

Software that supports clinical decisions but doesn't directly drive them: for example, a tool that records or displays patient data. It's low-risk, so manufacturer can self-certify compliance. No UK approved body assessment is required, though MHRA registration and technical documentation are still mandatory.
